podcast.body: Jay-Z collaborated with Linkin Park on the *Collision Course* album, released in 2004. This project took place during Linkin Park's hiatus between their studio albums. "then there was that collision course collaboration CD with Jay-Z."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was a collaborative mashup album created with Linkin Park, representing one of the "other projects" band members pursued during their downtime. "to do something like a mashup album with Jay-Z called Collision Course."
